test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. In row 1 – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south. In row 2 – P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north. Thus each person faces another person from the other row. Only three people sit to the right of R. D faces the person who is the immediate neighbour of S and P. C faces the person who sits second to the left of S. R does not face A.

Who amongst the following faces B?
solution:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south. In row 2 – P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north. 

1. Only three people sit to the right of R.

2. D faces the person who is the immediate neighbour of S and P.

3. C faces the person who sits second to the left of S.

4. R does not face A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06a7da6b0ba7467d70bc78df940cc805d7e11707e438def1da0f04db6c5d657a.png] 

R faces B.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
